findings.title: shrink: validate-and-reject block copied again (now in 4 routes)
findings.detail: The `reject()` helper, the `req.json()` try/catch returning INVALID_JSON, the `safeParse` returning VALIDATION_ERROR and the inlined `res.success === false ? 400 : 200` mapping (cancel route.ts:27-57, token route.ts:30-58) are near-verbatim copies of src/app/api/v1/appointments/route.ts:32-72 and src/app/api/v1/appointments/[id]/reassign/route.ts:33-74. Extract `badRequest(code, message)` + `parseBody(req, schema)` + the envelope-status mapping into one shared module under src/libs/api/. route-handler.ts is frozen and target_files is whitelisted, so this needs a follow-up unit.
